product.name: Sterve Business App
product.description: A mobile application for MSMEs to manage their business operations including inventory, sales, billing, and vendor management.

product.name: AI-Powered Personalized Marketing
product.description: An AI-driven feature that recommends relevant products or services to customers and enables businesses to send targeted promotional offers.

product.name: Billing and Payment Processing
product.description: A system to create bills, send them to customers, accept online payments, and track payment status.

product.name: Vendor Management
product.description: A tool to add and manage suppliers, track payables, and schedule timely payments.

product.name: Automated Bookkeeping and Financial Analysis
product.description: A bookkeeping platform that records sales and expenses, categorizes transactions, and provides financial reports.

product.name: Intelligent Inventory Management
product.description: A system that uses historical sales data and demand patterns to optimize inventory levels and reduce stockouts.
